# Omniflow contribution instructions

Follow the repository-wide rules in `AGENTS.md`.

Keep Remnawave authoritative for VPN technical state and Omniflow authoritative for commercial and customer-service state. Use explicit dependency wiring, PostgreSQL transactions, River jobs, the transactional outbox, generated OpenAPI types, Atlas migrations, sqlc, SWR, Zustand, React Hook Form, Zod, and next-intl according to those rules.

Do not add attribution text to source files, documentation, commits, or pull requests.
